dash.name: Dash
dash.text: Charge up to 3 hexes in a straight line and land where you click. Every enemy you pass takes a 60% hit. Click an enemy to dash past it; if there's no room behind it, you hit it and bounce back.

whirl.name: Whirl
whirl.text: A spinning cut that hits every hex around you.

spark.name: Spark
spark.text: A bolt of raw element at an enemy up to 2 hexes away. Elemental damage, from your elemental attack. Landing it gives back 10 Spirit, so it runs a little behind: about two basic attacks for every three Sparks. Needs a staff.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: A wide cut across the three hexes in front of you, toward the hex you click. Full damage to each.

piercing-shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing-shot.text: A shot that goes straight through: 90% to every enemy in a line of four hexes, toward the hex you click.

elemental-smite.name: Elemental Smite
elemental-smite.text: A burst of element on a hex up to 2 away: 80% elemental damage to it and the six hexes around it.

minor-heal.name: Minor Heal
minor-heal.text: Mend yourself for twice your elemental attack. Takes your turn.

fortify.name: Fortify
fortify.text: Brace: +10 and then +5% to both defences for 5 ticks.
